name: Sherman Oaks Galleria
description: Sherman Oaks Galleria is a premier lifestyle destination on Ventura Boulevard featuring a carefully curated mix of shopping, dining, and entertainment venues including Regal Cinemas. Providing magnificent experiences for over 30 years, the Galleria has evolved into a modern open-air center anchored by The Cheesecake Factory and Buffalo Wild Wings, with additional offerings like King David Bespoke Suits and Robeks Juice. The center hosts community events year-round including cultural celebrations and offers its Galleria Gold loyalty program for exclusive deals.
demographics: Sherman Oaks is an affluent neighborhood in Los Angeles's San Fernando Valley, attracting upper-middle-class professionals and families with high disposable income
summary: A modern lifestyle center in Sherman Oaks providing over 30 years of shopping, dining, and entertainment experiences on Ventura Boulevard
